verses.gurmukhi: ਹੋਇ ਸੁਚੇਤ ਅਚੇਤ ਇਵ ਅਖੀਂ ਹੋਂਦੀ ਅੰਨ੍ਹਾ ਹੋਆ।
verses.translit_en: hoi suchet achet iv akhee(n) ho(n)dhee a(n)nhaa hoaa|

en.bdb: The jiv though consciousness incarnate is so much unconscious (of his aim in life) as if he is blind though having the eyes;

verses.gurmukhi: ਵੈਰੀ ਮਿਤੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਦਾ ਡਾਇਣੁ ਮਾਉ ਸੁਭਾਉ ਸਮੋਆ।
verses.translit_en: vairee mit na jaanadhaa ddain maau subhaau samoaa|

en.bdb: Does not distinguish between a friend and a foe; and according to him the nature of a mother and a witch is identical.

verses.gurmukhi: ਬੋਲਾ ਕੰਨੀ ਹੋਂਦਈ ਜਸੁ ਅਪਜਸੁ ਮੋਹੁ ਧੋਹੁ ਨਾ ਸੋਆ।
verses.translit_en: bolaa ka(n)nee ho(n)dhiee jas apajas moh dhoh naa soaa|

en.bdb: He is deaf despite ears and does not distinguish between glory and infamy or between love and treachery.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁੰਗਾ ਜੀਭੈ ਹੁੰਦੀਐ ਦੁਧੁ ਵਿਚਿ ਵਿਸੁ ਘੋਲਿ ਮੁਹਿ ਚੋਆ।
verses.translit_en: gu(n)gaa jeebhai hu(n)dheeaai dhudh vich vis ghol muh choaa|

en.bdb: He is dumb despite tongue and drinks poison mixed in milk.

verses.gurmukhi: ਵਿਹੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਸਮਸਰ ਪੀਐ ਮਰਣ ਜੀਵਨ ਆਸ ਤ੍ਰਾਸ ਨ ਢੋਆ।
verses.translit_en: vih a(n)mirat samasar peeaai maran jeevan aas traas na ddoaa|

en.bdb: Considering poison and nectar identical he drinks them

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਰਪੁ ਅਗਨਿ ਵਲਿ ਹਥੁ ਪਾਇ ਕਰੈ ਮਨੋਰਥ ਪਕੜ ਖਲੋਆ।
verses.translit_en: sarap agan val hath pai karai manorath pakaR khaloaa|

en.bdb: And for his ignorance about life and death, hopes and desires, he gets no refuge anywhere.
He stretches his desires towards snake and fire and catching hold of them does not distinguish between a pit and a mound.
